text.en:
Section 8 of Republic Act Numbered Eighty-five, as amended, is hereby further amended to read
"Sec. 8. A private development bank shall exercise all the powers and shall assume all the obligations of a
savings and mortgage bank as provided in the General Banking Act, except as otherwise provided herein:
Provided, That no private development bank shall be operated without a certificate of authority from the
Monetary Board of the Central Bank which shall be issued upon compliance with the provisions of this law.
"Any existing domestic bank may be converted into a private development bank in the province or city which
it is located: Provided, That it complies with the requirements prescribed in this Act."
